entries.zh: 地里的坑、洞穴；挖出的土坑。
entries.en: hole or pit in the ground; a cave dug in the earth.
hole in the ground; cavity, cave.

entries.zh: 地中的洞穴与裂隙；缝隙。
entries.en: hole and cleft in the ground; crevice, gap.

entries.zh: 土中的洞窟、陷坑；（军事）反坑道。
entries.en: burrows and pits in the earth; (military) a countermine.
entries.notes: 「contramina」（反坑道）义在汉字与对音栏无对应，正文只取 竇陷 的洞窟、陷坑义，故降为 medium。
汉字栏「封门」与「锁孔」义不合，疑原稿误配或对音转写有误，释义依西语词头定为锁孔。

entries.zh: 孔洞；亦指管、导管、出水口。
entries.en: hole; also a pipe, tube or spout.

entries.zh: 葱管，葱（或洋葱）茎叶的中空管状部分；中空的管状孔。
entries.en: the hollow tube of a scallion or onion stalk; a hollow tubular opening.

entries.zh: 滴水、漏雨冲出的孔洞；漏洞。
entries.en: the hole made by a drip or leak; a drip-hole through which water leaks.

entries.zh: 端正合位的孔；钻凿得直的孔。
entries.en: a straight, true hole; a hole set in the proper position.
entries.notes: 「着势」为闽南语「合位、端正」义，与 derecho（端正、合位）勉强相合，但 R 栏对音与官话「着」差距较大，故降为 medium。

entries.en: to make a hole by striking; a hole so made.
to bore or gouge a hole.
to bore a hole; to gouge out an opening.
to make a hole; to pierce through.

entries.zh: 在石头上凿孔；啄凿石头成孔。
entries.en: to bore stone; to peck or chisel a hole in stone.
to chisel out a hole; to pierce a hole.
entries.notes: 汉字栏「托」当为「拓」（凿挖义），「一」疑为量词残迹，释义据 M 栏与西语词头推定。

entries.en: to bore a hole with a chisel.
a pierced or perforated thing; pierced through.
to pierce a hole; to perforate.
